index 0000000..3ebfef8

+++ b/src/standalone_error_secho.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+"""Styled output with injected helpers and no Click dependency."""
+
+import typing as t
+
+_T = t.TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+def error_secho(
+    echo: t.Callable[..., _T],
+    style: t.Callable[..., t.Any],
+    message: t.Any | None = None,
+    file: t.IO[str] | t.IO[bytes] | None = None,
+    nl: bool = True,
+    err: bool = True,
+    color: bool | None = None,
+    **styles: t.Any,
+) -> _T:
+    """Style a message and echo it, using stderr by default.
+
+    Pass ``None``, ``bytes``, and ``bytearray`` directly to ``echo``. For
+    other messages, pass the style keywords to ``style`` before echoing.
+    """
+    if message is not None and not isinstance(message, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        message = style(message, **styles)
+
+    return echo(message, file=file, nl=nl, err=err, color=color)
diff --git a/tests/test_standalone_error_secho.py b/tests/test_standalone_error_secho.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..514a2d5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_standalone_error_secho.py
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+from importlib.util import module_from_spec
+from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location
+from io import StringIO
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+from unittest.mock import sentinel
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def error_secho():
+    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_error_secho.py"
+    spec = spec_from_file_location("standalone_error_secho", path)
+    module = module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module.error_secho
+
+
+def test_error_secho_stream_selection(error_secho, runner):
+    with runner.isolation() as (out, err, _):
+        error_secho(click.echo, click.style, "error")
+        error_secho(click.echo, click.style, "output", err=False)
+
+        assert err.getvalue() == b"error\n"
+        assert out.getvalue() == b"output\n"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message", ["message", "", 0])
+def test_error_secho_styles_and_forwards_options(error_secho, message):
+    echo = Mock(return_value=sentinel.result)
+    style = Mock(return_value="styled")
+    stream = StringIO()
+
+    result = error_secho(
+        echo, style, message, stream, nl=False, err=False, color=True, fg="red"
+    )
+
+    style.assert_called_once_with(message, fg="red")
+    echo.assert_called_once_with("styled", file=stream, nl=False, err=False, color=True)
+    assert result is sentinel.result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message", [None, b"raw", b"", bytearray(b"raw"), bytearray()])
+def test_error_secho_bypasses_style(error_secho, message):
+    echo = Mock()
+    style = Mock()
+
+    error_secho(echo, style, message, fg="red")
+
+    style.assert_not_called()
+    echo.assert_called_once_with(message, file=None, nl=True, err=True, color=None)
+    assert echo.call_args.args[0] is message
+
+
+def test_error_secho_propagates_style_error(error_secho):
+    echo = Mock()
+
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        error_secho(echo, click.style, "message", unknown_style=True)
+
+    echo.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_error_secho_propagates_echo_error(error_secho):
+    echo = Mock(side_effect=OSError("write failed"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="write failed"):
+        error_secho(echo, click.style, "message")
notes:
Copied secho's control flow into a Click-independent module using injected echo and style callables, changing only the err default. Focused tests load the module by file path and cover stream selection, option forwarding, empty and binary inputs, and exception propagation.
